sampleBbox.note: Building footprints are only collected inside this small sample of the CBD. Building data in OSM Sydney is enormous and mostly un-heighted; a sample is enough to test schema and density, and to prove heights are usually absent.

stats.warning: Sample only. Heights are absent for the vast majority of footprints; no height is inferred anywhere in this pipeline.
